# Arbeitsagentur Germany & Austria Job Finder

Arbeitsagentur.de is the public job board of Germany's federal employment agency (Bundesagentur für Arbeit). Its index also carries postings supplied through Austria's AMS service and cross-border employers in neighbouring countries. This actor reads that public index without cookies, accounts or API keys, and returns one clean record per vacancy.

## What you can do

- Search by keyword, city, postal code or region with an optional radius.
- Choose regular employment, apprenticeships, internships/working-student roles or self-employment.
- Filter by contract type, working time, publication window, home office, disclosed salary, career-changer suitability, disability-friendly postings, private recruitment agencies, temporary work and external job boards.
- Narrow by exact employer, occupation, occupation field or city.
- Order results by relevance, publication date, last modification, start date or distance.
- Paste one or more Arbeitsagentur job URLs (or reference numbers) to fetch exactly those vacancies.
- Turn detail enrichment off when you only need the search-card fields.

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `search` | string | `Softwareentwickler` | Keyword searched in titles and descriptions. Leave empty to browse the index. |
| `location` | string | — | City, postal code or region. Use `Österreich` for the whole Austrian market. |
| `radius` | integer | `25` | Kilometres around `location`; ignored when no location is set. |
| `jobType` | string | `all` | All, employment, apprenticeship, internship/trainee or self-employment. |
| `contractType` | string | `all` | All, permanent, fixed-term, or either. |
| `workingTime` | string | `all` | All, full-time, part-time, shift/night/weekend, home-based work or minijob. |
| `publishedWithin` | string | `all` | Any date, today, last 1, 7, 14 or 28 days. |
| `sortBy` | string | `relevance` | Relevance, newest, recently modified, earliest start date or shortest distance. |
| `homeOffice` | string | `all` | Any arrangement, home office possible, at least 50%, or 100%. |
| `salaryDisclosure` | string | `all` | Any, annual salary disclosed, or hourly wage disclosed. |
| `careerChanger` | boolean | `false` | Only roles marked for career changers. |
| `disabilityFriendly` | boolean | `false` | Only roles for severely disabled or equivalent applicants. |
| `privatePlacementOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only private recruitment agency postings. |
| `excludeExternalBoards` | boolean | `false` | Hide postings that only link to a third-party board. |
| `excludeTempWork` | boolean | `false` | Hide temporary-work postings. |
| `employer` | string | — | Exact employer name. |
| `occupation` | string | — | Exact occupation title. |
| `occupationField` | string | — | Exact occupation field, e.g. `Informatik`. |
| `jobLocation` | string | — | Exact city filter; recommended for Austrian cities. |
| `jobUrls` | array | `[]` | Job-detail URLs or reference numbers; skips the keyword search. |
| `includeDetails` | boolean | `true` | Fetch description, all locations, contacts and employer profile. |
| `maxItems` | integer | `50` | Stop after this many records (1-10,000). |

### Example: permanent full-time nursing jobs near Munich

```json
{
  "search": "Krankenpfleger",
  "location": "München",
  "radius": 50,
  "jobType": "arbeit",
  "contractType": "permanent",
  "workingTime": "full-time",
  "publishedWithin": "28",
  "salaryDisclosure": "annual",
  "maxItems": 100
}
```

### Example: Austrian jobs in Vienna

```json
{
  "location": "Österreich",
  "jobLocation": "Wien",
  "maxItems": 50
}
```

### Example: fetch two known postings

```json
{
  "jobUrls": [
    "https://www.arbeitsagentur.de/jobsuche/jobdetail/10000-1202838080-S"
  ],
  "maxItems": 5
}
```

## Output

Every record is omit-empty: fields that the source does not provide for a vacancy are left out rather than filled with `null`, `0`, `false` or an empty string.

- **Identity:** `id`, `title`, `occupation`, `occupations`, `employer`, `jobType`.
- **Location:** `city`, `postalCode`, `street`, `region`, `country`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `distanceKm`, and `locations` with every work location.
- **Dates:** `publishedDate`, `modifiedTimestamp`, `startDate`.
- **Contract:** `contractDuration`, working-time flags, `isMinijob`, `quereinstiegSuitable`.
- **Salary:** `salary` (annual gross), `salaryAmount`, `salaryUnit`, `salaryCurrency`, `salaryMin`, `salaryMax`, `salaryType`, and `trainingSalaryYear1..4` for apprenticeships.
- **Details:** `description`, `educationRequirement`, `trainingType`, `homeOfficePossible`, `homeOfficeType`, `homeOfficePercent`, `isDisabilityFriendly`, `isPrivatePlacement`, `isTempWork`, `isManagedByEmployer`.
- **Employer profile:** `employerWebsite`, `employerDescription`, `employerBenefits`, `employerHeadquarters`, `employerFoundedYear`, `employerSize`, `employerKeywords`, `employerSocialLinks`, `employerContactInfo`.
- **Contact:** `contactEmails`, `contactPhones`.
- **Links:** `externalUrl`, `portalUrl`, `alliancePartnerName`, `alliancePartnerUrl`, `scrapedAt`.

## Typical uses

- Recruiters monitoring fresh openings by occupation and region.
- Labour-market analysts comparing contract mix, working time and disclosed pay.
- Relocation teams mapping job density from coordinates and distances.
- Career coaches collecting recent, relevant vacancies for a candidate.
- Data teams enriching employer profiles with websites, benefits and contact routes.

## Good to know

**Do I need an account or a proxy?**
No. The actor uses the same public job-search endpoints as the Arbeitsagentur website and runs without cookies or user-supplied proxy configuration.

**How many results can one run return?**
The source accepts at most 100 pages and requires `page × size` to stay at or below 10,000, so one query can return up to 10,000 vacancies. Split a very broad search by region, occupation field or offer type if you need more.

**Which publication windows work?**
The source supports today, 1, 7, 14 and 28 days. The actor exposes exactly those choices.

**Why do some salary or employer fields disappear?**
Employers decide whether to publish a salary, a website, benefits or contact details. The actor adds those fields only when Arbeitsagentur returns a real value.

**How do I search inside Austria?**
Set `location` to `Österreich`. To target an Austrian city, also set `jobLocation` to the city name, e.g. `Wien`.

**Why can the number of rows differ from the count on the website?**
The job index changes while a run paginates. Records are de-duplicated by reference number, so the final count can be slightly below the live total.

**Is this affiliated with the Bundesagentur für Arbeit?**
No. This is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by the Bundesagentur für Arbeit or Arbeitsagentur.de.
